title: Press-and-release feedback
blurb: Real EventTrigger pads compare play-forwards (no auto-rewind) with replay under repeated pointerdown or keydown.
question: Can the ChromeStatus press/release example (swell once on repeated pointerdown, shrink on pointerup) be built with EventTrigger alone in Chrome 158?
result: Partly. Repeated pointerdown/keydown on a finished play-forwards animation does not rewind and a mid-release press resumes from the current time; replay always restarts. The release half needs script: a second trigger on the same animation throws NotSupportedError and EventTrigger ignores its deactivate action.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 (Linux, headless) with --enable-blink-features=EventTrigger on 2026-11-25

friction.summary: An animation can belong to only one trigger
friction.repro: Open Live checks: addAnimation on a second EventTrigger throws NotSupportedError.
friction.workaround: Handle the opposite event in script with animation.reverse().

friction.repro: addAnimation(anim, 'play-forwards', 'play-backwards') then fire the event twice; playbackRate stays 1.

friction.summary: Idle animations still auto-rewind on the first trigger
friction.repro: Add a never-played Animation to an EventTrigger; Chromium enables auto-rewind for idle animations.
